column1: # What this skill needs on the target machine at runtime, and how badly.
# The client helpers are pure bash plus POSIX coreutils and always work.
# A chat SERVER needs one of the runtimes below to open a listening socket;
# each is optional because the chain falls through in order:
#   python3 -> node -> perl -> socat (driving the bash handler)
# Without any of them, chat-server.sh refuses with exit 69 and names the
# missing capability; send/read/tail against an existing log keep working.
